**Where is it?**
Page URL or path (e.g. `/duas`, or the section/dua/question title):

**What's wrong?**
Describe the mistake — typo, awkward translation, broken link, incorrect citation, etc.

**What should it say instead?**
If you know the fix, put it here — even a rough suggestion helps. If you'd rather fix it yourself, feel free to open a pull request instead of (or as well as) this issue.

**Language**
Which language did you see this in? (English, Български, Français, Deutsch, Nederlands, Türkçe, اردو)
